correctness.rationale: For d>=2,n>=2d, B_d(C_2d) is the join of boundaries of even and odd d-element classes. Rotation exchanges factors and simultaneously contributes a d-cycle sign, yielding +1, while the reflection preserves classes and has product restriction sign (-1)^(d-1). Every cyclic degree-one 0/1 contraction C_n→C_2d preserves faces: independent alternating d-colors would lift to an independent d-set in the source. Adjacent 01↔10 swaps differ at one source vertex, and forbidden target independent d-colors in a union would lift to an independent d-set in the original face, so induced maps are contiguous. Connectedness of fixed-weight binary words makes all normalized contractions homotopic. The published coloring map is a homotopy equivalence (d>=3), and degree-one circle mapping handles d=2. Normalized comparisons for f∘r and S∘f∘s transport the target orientation action to the source. For n>=2pd,d>=3, published equivariant inclusions preserve the representation. Finite-group rational invariants on barycentric-subdivided chain complexes give the quotient homology parity. Independent signed simplicial fixed-face traces matched predicted values in 240 group elements across 15 (d,n) cases, d=2..4, n=2d..2d+4, and 1,480 adjacent swap pairs over all fixed-weight increment words in d=2..4,n=2d+1..2d+3 were contiguous. Finite tests corroborate but do not establish infinite assertion.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison finds that Bayer et al. Theorem 4.15 and Carnero Bravo Corollary 32 determine the nonequivariant sphere, while Carnero Bravo Theorem 33 gives a non-equivariant cyclic block-coloring homotopy equivalence and equivariant inclusions for cycle powers. Neither theorem states a rotation/reflection homology character, and an abstract homotopy equivalence does not determine an action. The submitted adjacent-swap contiguity lemma proves the needed comparison of rotated/reflected coloring maps. The existing connected-bipartite 3-robust Euler-character formula implies the d=3 even-cycle subcase but does not treat d>3 or odd cycles. Kim–Lew treats collapsibility, not this representation. No independently prior complete character theorem or table was found. The already published matching SCOPE/Resultary entry is the assigned finding itself, and is explicitly excluded as independent prior art. The inaccessible 2026 Zaare-Nahandi full text is recorded as a residual priority risk rather than an automatic novelty failure.

value.rationale: The dihedral orientation module is a natural invariant of a family already known to be homotopy spheres and is not determined by their ordinary homotopy types. The uniform sign description distinguishes homology of cyclic and full dihedral orbit spaces, yielding a sharp parity-dependent rational quotient criterion for every d>=2,n>=2d, plus dihedrally equivariant cycle-power persistence for d>=3,n>=2pd. The adjacent-increment contiguity lemma is a mathematically motivated structural compatibility result, not a rote relabeling or unmotivated finite slice. Does not overclaim equivariant homotopy type or integral quotient torsion.
residual_risks: The resulting one-dimensional character is simple once the non-equivariant equivalence is made compatible with symmetry; its value is in the structural comparison and quotient consequence, not a new homotopy classification.
Cycle-power extensions are inherited from an existing inclusion theorem.

limitations: Proof imports all-parameter sphere, coloring homotopy and power inclusion theorems of Carnero Bravo.
Rational quotient homology only; no integral quotient torsion or equivariant homotopy equivalence asserted.
